newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS leaves 1997 GDP forecast at zero growth.
newsitem.headline: UBS leaves 1997 GDP forecast at zero growth.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said it had left its forecast for Swiss gross domestic product (GDP) unchanged at zero growth in 1997 in the light of data showing fourth-quarter 1996 GDP was unchanged from the third quarter.
"We assume we will have another year of stagnation," UBS analyst Martin Neff said. GDP fell 0.7 percent in 1996.

He told Reuters he thought the Swiss National Bank would not adjust its generous monetary policy until it saw whether the weaker Swiss franc would spur a slight export-led recovery in the second half of 1997.
The SNB would not ease further unless the franc gained sharply, he added.
